record.title: Venezuela Brazil currency-control closure December 2016
record.direction: Initial report describes all passage at the crossing; December 20 pedestrian release in both directions and Brazilian vehicle return into Brazil.
record.movement: Persons and vehicles at the named crossing according to Brazilian MRE; later pedestrian and registered Brazilian return phases differed.
record.exceptions: Registered Brazilian vehicle returns began December 19, with a 14h window and prior registration; pedestrian traffic in both directions released December 20.
record.enforcement: Brazilian consulate/MRE reported the Venezuelan gate closure from December 13. Documented Brazilian returns began December 19 before broader pedestrian release December 20.
record.relationship: Brazil-crossing implementation related to AM010 currency policy, not an additive independent national decision.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Prevent movement of withdrawn 100 bolivar banknotes.
record.uncertainty: Onset now supported as December 13 by a contemporary official report. December 20 is a pedestrian phase endpoint, not first passage or total reopening. A retrospective indexed IPEA passage gives January 6 reopening; full scope could not be inspected. Do not bridge December 19/20 openings into a single universal closed spell.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
